status: nominal CAD/manufacturer alignment; not physical calibration
method: XY: vertical radius-49.75 mm window cylinder axis, coincident with radius-3000 mm field axis. Z: horizontal window top minus manufacturer 40.1 mm. Yaw: away from rear rectangular casing/support, along outward CAD diagonal. CAD simplified body is 135.0 mm tall versus datasheet 135.1 mm; use top datum, not base height.
ros_convention: SICK ROS2 driver shifts native beam angles by -90 degrees; frame +X is outward scan bisector, +Z up. No extra 90-degree URDF rotation.
